PG - 2015 Internal Candidates Discrepancy In Documents
Wednesday, 24 December 2014
6578 Hits
We have received your application for admission in PG courses 2015-16. After scrutiny of application form and certificates submitted by you, it was found that you have not submitted the required certificates, therefore all are advised to see the attached document showing deficiency of his./her certificate and submit the same in  person or through email
dean@mgims.ac.in
on or before 26th December 2014 by 12 noon in the Dean’s Office.
No enquiry in this regard will be made on telephone. Students are directed to contact through email or come in person for enquiry.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
